role: Safe, rounding conversion of date intervals to Int64 milliseconds, rejecting NaN/infinite/±100-year values.

units.does: Rounded ms between two dates, nil if unrepresentable.

flags.text: Type doc says the conversion is 'needed in two places — ImportSleepWindow ... and RRCollector', but MillisecondOffset is used from 24 production files (SessionMerger, RRModels, OvernightChartsView, MorningProcessingService, ReanalysisService, SessionRecoveryService, DemoSessionSeeder, PolarManager+Streaming, ...).

units.does: Rounded ms between two dates, or the caller's fallback when unrepresentable.

flags.text: The type's stated rationale is that nil 'lets the caller say it does not know' instead of inventing a plausible value, yet 50 of 53 production call sites use between(_:and:fallback: 0), so a corrupt/out-of-range date silently becomes a 0 ms offset (e.g. imported beats rebased at offset 0 in SessionMerger, sleep boundaries at recording start in OvernightChartsView+Stats).

units.does: seconds*1000 rounded to Int64 when within ±100 years, else nil (NaN fails both comparisons).
